followup_explanation:
I weighed two things: capability fit and any preference/tone factors flagged in the documentation.

**Capability fit was the main driver.** Your request is essentially a structured extraction-and-organization task — take a defined responsibility statement and break it out into discrete roles and responsibilities. That maps to the "Extraction & Retrieval" and "Summarization" eval dimensions, where Petrel leads by a margin well above the 2.0-point noise threshold (85.3 vs 78.5 and 86.4 vs 79.9). Petrel also leads on the general reasoning/instruction benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, IFEval, Arena-Hard), so there was no countervailing reason to prefer Lapwing.

**Preferences were a minor, secondary consideration.** The "don't overcomplicate it like usual" phrasing carries a mildly impatient/hostile edge. Lapwing self-reports declining preference as request warmth decreases, while Petrel's preference response across tone is essentially flat. That nudged in the same direction as the capability call, but it wasn't decisive — capability alone already pointed to Petrel.

In short: Petrel was the stronger fit on the relevant skill, and nothing about the task pulled the other way.
